findings.rule: Dependency rule — domain contract imports infrastructure
findings.explanation: The shared domain contract imports the Drizzle row type ReportRunRow from modules/reports/repository.ts and embeds it in the wire DTO (ReportDetailDto.latestRun). vendor/shared is the innermost ring and may import only other domain code and Zod — this edge points outward, exposes a raw Drizzle row shape on the HTTP boundary instead of a mapped DTO, and, since vendor/shared is mirrored into client/, it would pull server-only db/schema types into the client package.
findings.fix: Define latestRun in the contract as a Zod/domain shape (only the fields the wire needs) and map ReportRunRow to that shape in modules/reports/helpers.ts; remove the import from the contract.
